summary: Heritage Global Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a New Credit Facility with C3bank, National Association on September 16, 2026. The facility is a $10.0 million revolving line of credit maturing January 16, 2028, priced at prime plus 1.00% with a 7.500% floor, plus an annual unused line fee. Proceeds are restricted to business operations. The facility is secured by substantially all assets and subsidiary equity pledges; it carries customary affirmative, negative and financial covenants. This is a routine financing disclosure, not a special situation.
